personality: 5 Brutalist Mobile / 1 iOS-Native Clean (Industrial Food ERP)
personality_one_liner: High-contrast, flour-dusted industrial bakery ERP designed for rapid shop-floor execution, precise baker's math, and strict HACCP traceability.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets for flour-dusted hands, compact metadata, 8pt rhythm.

screens.name: Dashboard & Passaggio Consegne
screens.purpose: Live KPI cards, shift handover notes (Notte/Mattina/Pomeriggio), urgent alerts, and today's baking schedule sorted by oven temperature.

states.empty: Nessun dato di produzione registrato per oggi.
states.error: Errore di sincronizzazione con il server del laboratorio.

screens.layout: Scrollable vertical dashboard with top operational mode switcher (Bottega / GDO / Industriale), KPI summary cards grid, filterable Shift Handover notes accordion with priority tags, and chronological oven schedule list.

screens.name: Ricettario & Calcolatore
screens.purpose: Baker's percentage recipe database, batch scaler by total dough or pieces, water temperature calculator, and EU 1169/2011 allergen label generator.
screens.layout: Grid of 4 preloaded artisan recipes with quick action buttons for scaling and allergen label generation, plus interactive baker's math calculator.

screens.name: Produzione & Fermentazione
screens.purpose: Kanban status pipeline from [Da Impastare] to [Sfornato], fermentation timers, and sourdough starter feeding tracker.

states.error: Errore nel caricamento degli stati di fermentazione.

screens.layout: Horizontal swipeable or vertical status column Kanban view with timer badges and stage advancement triggers.

screens.name: Magazzino & Tracciabilità HACCP
screens.purpose: Raw materials inventory with low-stock warnings, lot traceability, allergen sheets, and temperature logs.
screens.layout: Tabbed inventory list with low-stock badges, lot codes, and temperature verification logs.

screens.name: Invenduto, Resi & Costi
screens.purpose: End-of-day unsold log, bread crumb/crouton conversion suggestions, and food cost/margin analytics.

states.error: Errore nel calcolo dei costi di produzione.

screens.layout: Financial KPI summary with unsold item breakdown and zero-waste conversion actions.

screens.name: Reportistica & Export
screens.purpose: Planned vs actual production charts, waste trend analysis, flour consumption, and print-friendly daily shift sheet.

states.empty: Dati insufficienti per il periodo selezionato.
states.error: Errore durante la generazione del report PDF.

screens.layout: Comparative charts and export action sheet for daily bakery reporting.

hero_bread.alt: Artisan sourdough bread loaf on rustic wood table

bakery_lab.alt: Commercial bakery stainless steel kitchen and oven

instructions_to_main_agent: Build PanificioOS in React Native with full tablet responsiveness (768-1024px support), 3 operational modes (Bottega Artigianale, GDO, Industriale), 4 preloaded Italian recipes with EU 1169/2011 allergen labels, shift handover notes with Notte/Mattina/Pomeriggio filters and priority tags, Baker's math calculator, Kanban production pipeline, HACCP logs, and inventory management. Use the Flour & Slate color palette (#F8F9FA background, #1E293B slate sidebar, #D97706 terracotta/crust orange accents). Ensure touch targets are large for flour-dusted hands.
